peer-approval.description: Who approved the pull request that produced this commit

code-quality-gate.description: SonarQube quality gate of the analysis of this exact commit

secret-detection.description: Secrets TruffleHog finds in the files of this commit. Records where they are, never the secrets

secrets-path.description: Directory to scan, relative to the workspace (default .)

secrets-verify.description: true to ask each provider whether a secret found works (default false)

sca.description: Known vulnerabilities in the dependencies of this commit, found by Grype

sca-target.description: dir:<path> or sbom:<file> to scan (default dir:.)

sca-fail-on.description: Lowest severity that makes the result fail: critical, high, medium, low or negligible (default high)

custom.description: Anything a squad wants to declare itself. Signed with the self key, never platform-verified

predicate-file.description: Path to a file that holds one JSON object
